mapper.select: SELECT * FROM business_policies WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND effective_to IS NULL ORDER BY policy_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO business_policies (company_id, is_agreed, markup_rate, effective_from, set_by, set_reason) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{isAgreed}, #{markupRate}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{setBy}, #{setReason})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM business_policies WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND effective_from < DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY effective_from DESC, policy_id DESC LIMIT 1
